subject: general
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (All numbers are single-digit numbers only).

(Left) 7 9 1 8 4 2 5 6 3 8 7 1 9 (Right)

How many odd numbers are there (from left to right) which are immediately followed by even numbers?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 7 9 1 8 4 2 5 6 3 8 7 1 9 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers which are immediately followed by even numbers.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd - Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70aedd9a36fd60c3847aabf7ebe67c8b7eb6ef9d4be4f6fd76c1cacde2d709f4.png] 

Thus, there are three odd numbers, each of which is immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
